thread:
Maya (Growth): Quick sync — launching webinar + benchmark narrative next Wed. Need final SEO checklist: keywords, schema (FAQ + Event), internal linking plan across launch posts, and a redirect map for gated assets. Can we lock by EOD tomorrow?
Aj Sharma: I can own redirect map. question: do we gate the full benchmark PDF or just the summary? gating affects redirects + canonical choices.
Maya (Growth): Gate the full PDF behind form, keep summary public. Need a clean redirect from /benchmark -> /benchmark-summary and /benchmark/pdf -> gated URL (301).
Lucy (Content): I'll finish keyword targets today. Current plan: 3 pillar keywords (benchmark narrative, webinar insights, cost-per-token optimization) + 6 longtails for internal posts. Will share spreadsheet.
Tom C: Important: canonical tags on summary page must point to /benchmark-summary, and gated PDF page should be noindex, follow. Also ensure the open graph points to summary for socials.
SEO Bot: crawl-report: found 12 near-duplicate meta descriptions across /blog/launch-posts. Recommend unique 120-160 char metas.
Aj Sharma: Draft redirect rules snippet for infra (nginx/apache style):
```
# redirects for launch
rewrite ^/benchmark$ /benchmark-summary permanent; # 301
rewrite ^/benchmark/pdf$ /gated/benchmark-download permanent; # gated
rewrite ^/webinar$ /webinar/register permanent; # landing -> register
```
Will add source -> target CSV for dev.
Lucy (Content): For internal linking: 1) add context links from all related launch posts to the benchmark-summary (use exact anchor text "benchmark results"); 2) add a featured link on homepage teaser to webinar register; 3) add sidebar related-posts widget that surfaces webinar + benchmark.
Maya (Growth): Good. Also we need JSON-LD for Event & FAQ. Tom, can you paste minimal snippets we can hand to devs?
Tom C: putting minimal FAQ schema: 
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {"@type":"Question","name":"What does the benchmark measure?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"End-to-end inference latency and cost at scale."}},
    {"@type":"Question","name":"Who should attend the webinar?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Engineers and product leads running LLM inference."}}
  ]
}
```
And Event snippet for webinar (date placeholders) — devs will swap actual ISO date.
Aj Sharma: I'll include redirect 301s in deploy and add tests. One ask: can marketing provide the exact gated slug? we need it for the mapping.
Lucy (Content): gated slug: /gated/benchmark-download. Also sending canonical map in the spreadsheet (col: old_url, new_url, canonical, noindex).
Maya (Growth): Nice. Priorities for EOD tomorrow: Lucy -> keyword sheet + canonical column; Aj -> CSV of redirects + small curl test commands; Tom -> JSON-LD snippets + OG meta recommendations; I'll coordinate copy for registration CTA and email.
Tom C: curl test examples for Aj: 
```
# check redirect
curl -I https://redwood.example.com/benchmark
# expect: HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
# Location: https://redwood.example.com/benchmark-summary
```
Aj Sharma: I'll run linkbot after deploy and post results. If we see any 302s or trailing-slash issues we convert to 301s.
Maya (Growth): One more thing — QA for canonicalization on paginated content. Add a checklist item: pagination rel=prev/next or noindex second pages? thoughts?
Tom C: Keep paginated blog lists indexable; ensure rel=prev/next present. If duplicates persist, add canonical to page 1.
Lucy (Content): I'll reduce duplicate snippets and ensure meta uniqueness.
SEO Bot: scheduled: run broken-link sweep tomorrow 08:00 UTC; will DM results.
Maya (Growth): Perfect. I'll post final signoff once we have CSV + snippets. Thx team :rocket:
